notes.title: Feb. 2021 Update Is Live!
notes.content:
A long overdue update just went live for Soviet Bear Uni Adventure! Bellow you'll find the patch notes. Have fun!

[list]
[*] The game is now available in Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Russian (in addition to English).
[*] Keys "J" and "L" can now be used for leaning, in addition to the arrow keys as before.
[*] Death animations can now be skipped by pressing any key other than "Esc". This was requested by many players.
[*] The option to start a new game before finishing the current run has been added to the main menu.
[*] 7 Steam Achievements have been added to the game.
[*] The skybox has been changed as many players disliked the previous one. This impacts lighting slightly as well.
[*] Minor changes to post processing.
[*] Minor change to the floating log obstacle.
[*] Graphics settings are now automated. This is obviously not ideal but had to be done in order to avoid delaying this update indefinitely due to changes to the engine the game was built in. Considering the lightweight nature of the game, this is unlikely to cause an issue for most players. Resolution is now determined by the user's system settings.
[/list]
